body:
BLOCK exact 6a218927a3492e27d34915aed4bcbf269bb004e7 after the assigned construction/wire/v4 review.

Positive evidence: base e584ad6, exact 12-path delta, and git diff --check are clean. In an exact git-archive export, supportprobe.SupportAssessmentSuite plus storymodel4s.align.WireSuite passed 24/24, and storymodel4s.codec.AlignCodecSuite passed 15/15. The v4 tag and explicit hsmm/v3 refusal are present and green. I preserve the disclosed limit: fresh Native inference has separate 1-ULP drift, so this is not whole-result cross-platform byte-identity evidence.

BLOCKER — the new Assessed claim is forgeable through an open package namespace. cost.scala uses private[align] on all three concrete constructors and private[storymodel4s] on assessedFromWire/unestablished/notApplicable. Scala packages are open to downstream code. A temp-only exact-candidate probe in package storymodel4s.align.attack compiled and reached every constructor plus assessedFromWire. It built Assessed(0.5, {Semantic}); for that one-term eligible population public assess can derive only 0.0 or 1.0, yet public AlignWire.costBreakdown accepted the impossible 0.5 value. Probe passed 1/1, exit 0; source SHA-256 639f1cc634a325a24c8cb558c13557b4023018cf79bc32880c55bac0ab50a59a. Existing package supportprobe refusal checks miss the spoofed namespace and do not test direct new-constructor access. This defeats the advertised Cartesian-product boundary and lets an unsupported numeric license inhabit a checked wire result.

Required successor: make derived SupportAssessment construction genuinely inaccessible to downstream package-name spoofing and ensure every deserialization door has enough admitted context to prove or recompute the share. Add exact storymodel4s.align.attack and storymodel4s.consumerattack refusal courts for direct constructors and rehydration, with a mutation that opens the door and dies. If the wire cannot prove derivation because weights are absent, represent a reported wire claim as a different honest type/status instead of materializing derived Assessed.

SHOULD-HAVE-CHANGED: codec/README.md:29,34 and docs/adr/0001-embedding-contract-and-hard-gate.md:286 still publish hsmm/v1 while this candidate makes hsmm/v4 canonical. bd-01M1D214VVRE118RTEQQ09P7SA tracks that drift; either include the correction in the successor or make that bead a landing-order dependency so main is never published with false schema docs.

No other blocker found in my assigned v4/refusal/scope focus. Candidate remains ancestor-blocked and unauthorized independently of this review.
